title: The Game Watched by a Thousand

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After a lively ball game, a teenager wonders whether distant people gather in crowds just to watch others play.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a lively ball game on the beach, (name1), a teenager, wonders whether distant people might gather in huge crowds just to watch others play.

choices.label: Imagine Games Played for Fun Alone.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The players imagine a crowd so loud that no one could hear the score; they cheer each other twice as loudly in practice.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A quiet villager says they would find such noise exhausting, and nobody argues.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child suggests that distant children might play just as they do, with made-up rules and arguments.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder wonders whether games far away could become so serious that the fun goes out of them.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The players wonder whether everyone far away would get a turn, or only the best; they decide everyone gets a turn here.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager who uses a wheelchair imagines games built for every kind of body; the others start designing one immediately.
